{{Short description|French mathematician}}
[[File:Eutaris in Mr Vuibert's Journal du Mathématiques Alimentaires November 1877 Vol. II. pp. 30, 43.jpg|thumb|Eutaris in Vuibert's ''Journal du Mathématiques Alimentaires'', November 1877, Vol. II, pp. 30, 43]]
'''M. Restiau''', also known by the [[anagram]]atic pen name '''Eutaris''', was a French mathematician who first postulated what is now known as a [[Taylor circle]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Thomas |first1=Paul D. |last2=Dragoo |first2=R. C. |last3=Clarke |first3=Walter B. |last4=MacKay |first4=D. L. |last5=Fon |first5=J. E. La |last6=Grossman |first6=Howard D. |last7=Miller |first7=Franklin |last8=Arena |first8=J. Frank |last9=Hoff |first9=E. |last10=Aude |first10=H. T. R. |last11=Mind |first11=Nev. R. |last12=Starke |first12=E. P. |last13=Thebault |first13=V. |last14=Court |first14=N. A. |date=October 1943 |title=Problem Department |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/3029917 |journal=National Mathematics Magazine |volume=18 |issue=1 |pages=39 |doi=10.2307/3029917 |jstor=3029917 |access-date=2024-03-22 |archive-date=2024-03-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240322152419/https://www.jstor.org/stable/3029917?origin=crossref |url-status=live |url-access=subscription }}</ref>

According to an 1895 article by [[John Sturgeon Mackay]] about triangle symmetry, "The property, that the six projections of the vertices of the orthic triangle on the sides of the fundamental triangle are eoncyclic, seems to have been first published in [[Henry Vuibert|Mr Vuibert]]'s ''Journal du Mathématiques Alimentaires'' in November 1877. See Vol. II. pp. 30, 43. It is proposed by Eutaris. This name, as my friend Mr [[Philbert Maurice d'Ocagne|Maurice D'Ocagne]] informs me, was assumed anagrammatically by M. Restiau, at that time a {{lang|fr|répétiteur}} [tutor] in the [[Lycée Chaptal|Collège Chaptal]], Paris."<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Mackay |first=J. S. |author-link=John Sturgeon Mackay |date=February 1895 |title=Symmedians of a Triangle and their concomitant Circles |url=http://www.journals.cambridge.org/abstract_S0013091500031758 |journal=Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society |language=en |volume=14 |pages=37–103 |doi=10.1017/S0013091500031758 |issn=0013-0915}}</ref> An article in ''L'Intermédiaire des mathématiciens'' from 1895 adds one biographical detail but also floats a different credit: "{{lang|fr|Le premier croit que la signature Eutaris était le pseudonyme (par anagramme) de M. Restiau, ancien élève de l'École Polytechnique, répétiteur au Collège Chaptal en 1877; [[Emilé Vigarié|M. Vigarié]], au contraire, croit que l'article dont il s'agit avait pour auteur M. Vuibert.}}"<ref>{{Cite journal |journal=[[L'Intermédiaire des mathématiciens]] |page=166 |title=REPONSES. |year=1895 |volume=II |url=https://ttu-ir.tdl.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/b191af2b-d2fe-48ad-aa48-12f2bb5eac22/content |via=[[Texas Tech|Texas Tech University Libraries]] |access-date=2024-03-22 |archive-date=2024-03-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240323033912/https://ttu-ir.tdl.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/b191af2b-d2fe-48ad-aa48-12f2bb5eac22/content |url-status=live }}</ref> A [[machine translation]] by Google reads, "The first [J. S. Mackay] believes that the signature Eutaris was the pseudonym (by anagram) of Mr. Restiau, former student of the [[École polytechnique|École Polytechnique]], tutor at Collège Chaptal in 1877; Mr. Vigarié, on the contrary, believes that the article in question<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal de mathématiques élémentaires année 1-2 Jan.1877-Juil.15,1878. |url=https://hdl.handle.net/2027/pst.000055397322?urlappend=%3Bseq=164 |access-date=2024-03-22 |website=HathiTrust | hdl=2027/pst.000055397322?urlappend=%3Bseq=164 |at=image scan 164 |language=fr}}</ref> was authored by Mr. Vuibert."
